teaser.en: Bright yellow flowers light up the dry bush in the cool season, and its roots are one of the best-known Digo remedies.
teaser.sw: Maua ya manjano angavu hung'arisha vichaka vikavu wakati wa baridi, na mizizi yake ni mojawapo ya dawa za Kidigo zinazojulikana zaidi.
teaser.dg: Wakati wa mnyevu, maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganaala kahi ya vitsaka vikavu, na miziye ni kahi ya dawa za Chidigo zinazomanyikana sana.

summary.en: *Muhumba* is the winter cassia, a shrub of the bush with bright yellow flowers and long pods, often seen on termite mounds. Its roots are among the popular Digo medicines, used for stomach pains and many other ailments.
summary.sw: *Muhumba* ni mbaraka (winter cassia), kichaka cha porini chenye maua ya manjano angavu na maganda marefu, ambacho mara nyingi huonekana juu ya vichuguu. Mizizi yake ni miongoni mwa dawa maarufu za Kidigo, ikitumika kwa maumivu ya tumbo na maradhi mengine mengi.
summary.dg: *Muhumba* ni *winter cassia* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha weruni chenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganayoala na makakaya mare, na mara nyinji nkuonekana dzulu ya vitsulu. Miziye ni kahi ya dawa za Chidigo zinazomanyikana sana, na nkuhumirwa kpwa kulumwa ni ndani na makongo ganjina manji.

about.en: *Muhumba* is a shrub or small tree. Its bark is red on young stems and turns grey with age. Each leaf carries 4 to 10 pairs of leaflets. In flower it is covered in bright yellow blooms, often while the branches are nearly bare, and these are followed by long, hanging pods.
about.sw: *Muhumba* ni kichaka au mti mdogo. Gamba lake ni jekundu kwenye mashina machanga na hugeuka kijivu kadiri unavyozeeka. Kila jani lina jozi 4 hadi 10 za vijani. Unapochanua hufunikwa na maua ya manjano angavu, mara nyingi wakati matawi yakiwa karibu matupu, na baada ya maua huja maganda marefu yanayoning'inia.
about.dg: *Muhumba* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide. Gophare ni ra kundu kpwenye mihi midide, na richikula rinakala ra rangi ya ivu. Chila kodza rina jozi 4 hadi 10 za makodza madide. Uchikala na maruwa, unafwinikwa ni maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganayoala, mara nyinji wakati makodza ga pandaze gakagbwa phephi gosi; bada ya maruwa higo kunatuluka makakaya mare ganayogbwadzika.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland, and is often found growing on termite mounds. It is easiest to spot when in flower.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na nyasi zenye miti, na mara nyingi hupatikana ukiota juu ya vichuguu. Ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua unapochanua.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi, na mara nyinji nkuphahikana dzulu ya vitsulu. Ni rahisi kuuona wakati una maruwa.

uses.en: The roots are used for many ailments, for example stomach pains, and it is counted among the popular Digo medicines. The bark is a source of tannin.
uses.sw: Mizizi hutumika kwa maradhi mengi, kwa mfano maumivu ya tumbo, na huhesabiwa miongoni mwa dawa maarufu za Kidigo. Gamba ni chanzo cha tanini.
uses.dg: Miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa makongo manji, kpwa mfwano kulumwa ni ndani, na ni kahi ya dawa za Chidigo zinazomanyikana sana. Gophare rinalavya *tannin*.

names.en: Pakia and ICRAF record the Digo name *muhumba*; in Giriama it is *muhumbu*, in Swahili *mbaraka*, and in English winter cassia. The Mgombato dictionary gives *muhumba* to a different plant, the stinking weed or wild coffee (*Cassia occidentalis*), with the Swahili names *mkengajua*, *mnukauvundo*, *mwingajini* and *mnyafungo*.
names.sw: Pakia na ICRAF zinarekodi jina la Kidigo *muhumba*; kwa Kigiriama ni *muhumbu*, kwa Kiswahili *mbaraka*, na kwa Kiingereza *winter cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inalipa jina *muhumba* mmea mwingine, *stinking weed* au *wild coffee* (*Cassia occidentalis*), wenye majina ya Kiswahili *mkengajua*, *mnukauvundo*, *mwingajini* na *mnyafungo*.
names.dg: Pakia na ICRAF anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muhumba*; kpwa Chigiryama ni *muhumbu*, kpwa Chiswahili *mbaraka*, na kpwa Chingereza *winter cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha dzina *muhumba* mmea wanjina, *stinking weed* au *wild coffee* (*Cassia occidentalis*), wenye madzina ga Chiswahili *mkengajua*, *mnukauvundo*, *mwingajini* na *mnyafungo*.

reason.en: Long-pod cassia, close relative with a similar name
reason.sw: *Muhumba tsaka* (long-pod cassia), jamaa wa karibu mwenye jina linalofanana
reason.dg: *Muhumba tsaka*, ndugu wa phephi wenye dzina rinalohalana.

reason.sw: Msegese, mmea mwingine wa porini wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: *Mtseketse*, mmea wanjina wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde.

reason.sw: Mchinjiri, dawa nyingine maarufu ya Kidigo
reason.dg: *Mchinjiri*, dawa yanjina ya Chidigo inayomanyikana sana.

reason.en: Another popular Digo medicine of the bush
reason.sw: Dawa nyingine maarufu ya Kidigo ya porini
reason.dg: Dawa yanjina ya Chidigo ya weruni inayomanyikana sana.
